scope: Curated finite execution evidence, not theorem certification; no upstream commit authentication.

lean.log_source_linkage: Lean log itself does not contain per-source hashes; snapshot/current Lean source agreement is reported separately.

separately_recorded_visual_spot_check.finding: No clipping or overlap on sampled pages; not a visual inspection of all 256 pages.

snapshot_to_observed_tree.interpretation: Observation-time inventory only. Later documentation, dossier and generated TeX finalization is separate from the immutable execution snapshot; this is not a claim that every final-tree byte was executed.

normalization.policy: UTF-8 text: literal replacement of environment-dependent absolute root prefixes by declared semantic placeholders. All remaining bytes, including embedded hashes, are preserved. Raw hashes refer to original artifacts, not normalized copies. No source-manifest keys or values are changed.

placeholders.${CURRENT_REPOSITORY}: repository used for fresh C++ compilation
